title: S8 Asset and Lifecycle Field Definition Fields

entries.name: Schema ID
entries.description: Stable identifier of the governed asset or lifecycle schema to which the field belongs.

entries.name: Field Group ID
entries.description: Stable identifier of the logical field group, such as identification, location, performance or maintenance.

entries.name: Field ID
entries.description: Stable governed identifier for the lifecycle field.

entries.name: Description / Intended Meaning
entries.description: Declared semantic meaning and intended lifecycle use of the field.

entries.name: Data Type
entries.description: Governed data type such as text, number, date, Boolean, list or another declared type.

entries.name: Allowed Values / Domain
entries.description: Controlled value set, range, reference list or other governed domain where applicable.

entries.name: Required / Optional Basis
entries.description: Required, optional or conditionally required state, tied to a declared lifecycle use or information requirement rather than assumed globally.

entries.name: Source System / Responsibility
entries.description: Authoritative source system, producing party, governed role or other traceable responsibility for the field value.

entries.name: Lifecycle Use Reference
entries.description: Reference to the lifecycle purpose, information requirement, project scope or schema rule that creates demand for the field.

entries.name: Status
entries.description: Governed lifecycle state of the field definition, such as proposed, approved, deprecated or superseded.

entries.name: Effective From
entries.description: Date, version or governed condition from which the field definition applies.

governance_notes: Field definitions shall be purpose-driven and aligned with explicit S2 lifecycle information requirements; requiredness shall not be inferred merely because a field exists in a source template.
Client-specific or proprietary field lists remain separate governed artifacts or external authoritative references; this registry defines the governance fields needed to describe them.
Field semantics, data types, domains and source responsibility must be versioned so downstream validation can distinguish current from deprecated definitions.

provenance.source_title: Governance Metadata and Asset Schema Registry
provenance.migration_note: Migrates the field-group and field-definition layer of GAP-S8-03 without embedding any client-specific schema table or proprietary asset template.
